title: Kustodiev
description: Kustodiev has a strong, striking presence, with a blue smoke and white coat that gives him a rich, refined look and beautiful depth through his fur. His clear blue eyes add a memorable softness to his expression, balancing his confident overall impression. He carries himself with quiet assurance and a calm, steady nature that feels both composed and intelligent. There is a lovely strength to his character, matched by a warm, observant expression that makes him especially appealing. Kustodiev is a truly impressive boy, with both substance and elegance in equal measure.
